g.text: CONNECTED SCHEMATIC • Rev C · budget SMT • Review drawing, 30 September 2026
Dots join wires. Crossings without dots do not join.
Follow left to right. All four op-amp sections use +5V_A and GND; power pins are drawn at lower right.
Load ≥100k; external amp owns its mute.
Floating current loop; optocoupler output is pulled up only to Pi 3.3 V.
DIN 1/2/3: NC. Shell insulated and unconnected.
Shown de-energized above: external tip grounded.
JP301 normal: 1–3 + 2–4. Reversed: 3–5 + 4–6. Both shunts move together.
Rail symbols connect repeated supplies. Ground ≠ chassis until R101.
R101 · TVS return → GND → jack sleeves → aluminium enclosure
J101 is ONE 40-pin header shown in functional groups. Unused J101 pins, U201.3, U301.2 and DIN 1/2/3 are NC on this expansion.
77 PCB components + 3 panel sockets. KiCad source is authoritative.
